clause_name: RLA-560 — Residential Lease — Lease Modifications and Governing Law
library_question: Will material changes be signed by all required parties, with Kansas law and the proper county venue governing?

blocks.text: Material changes to Rent, Security Deposit, lease term, utilities, fees, or substantive Lease obligations must be in a written amendment signed by Landlord and all adult Tenants, except for lawful changes to rules, month-to-month terms, or changes otherwise allowed by law. Oral modifications are not binding.
This Lease is governed by Kansas law. Venue for court proceedings is in the Kansas county where the Premises is located, unless applicable law requires otherwise.
